indicator_name: National Fund of Kazakhstan Savings Portfolio
methodology: Built from 7 of 14 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (0 skipped). USD (not KZT). National Fund 'savings portfolio' (Сберегательный портфель) sub-total -- the larger, diversified (bonds/equities/gold/alternative instruments) portion of the Fund. A POINT-IN-TIME snapshot as of each calendar quarter-end, not a cumulative flow (unlike most other minfin bulletin-sourced indicators). Originally sourced by Minfin FROM the National Bank RK, republished here in the Statistical Bulletin. Document TITLES are NOT used to determine period -- only each document's own internal 'ЗА N КВАРТАЛ YYYY ГОДА' header text is trusted.
